Class BeanDestructionOrder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.BeanDestructionOrder
@Internal public final class BeanDestructionOrder extends Object
Orders an existing set of scope-owned instances without resolving additional beans or taking ownership. Dependencies outside the supplied set remain controlled by their scopes.

  • Method Details

    • sort

      public static <T extends CreatedBean<?>> List<T> sort(Collection<T> beans)
      Sorts registrations into the order in which they should be destroyed.

      A bean is destroyed before every bean it requires, whether the requirement comes from an injection point or from DependsOn, or from dynamically resolved dependencies, so that a dependency outlives its dependents. Where the dependencies leave the order open, destruction listeners are kept last and beans are destroyed in bean name order so that the sequence is stable between runs. A dependency cycle cannot satisfy that guarantee for every one of its members, so it is broken by destroying the first bean in name order that lies on a cycle; beans that merely depend on a cycle are never chosen to break it.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The registration type
      Parameters:
      beans - The registrations
      Returns:
      The registrations in destruction order
